MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits the wiring work suggested by my battery holder, relay, and PCB supplies because it would help insulate connections in those projects.",
    "The caliper connects reasonably to measuring parts for DIY assembly, although I would need a specific project before choosing a tool that large."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The filament recommendations assume a printing need that my electronics purchases do not establish; different colors and materials do not make them useful to me right now.",
    "The feeler gauge and threaded inserts serve specific tasks and dimensions that I have not shown a need for, while twelve tubes of glue feel excessive without a planned repair.",
    "The second heat shrink assortment is relevant, but I would not buy both kits for the same wiring need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in building electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing supplies.",
    "My occasional furniture and DIY purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy specialized hardware without checking whether its particular use fits my projects."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The clearest connection across my electronics purchases is assembling and wiring small components, which makes practical connection supplies especially relevant.",
    "I choose tools and materials when they solve a concrete task; broad DIY relevance alone is not enough, especially for large tools or bulk packs.",
    "Two products can both suit my interests while filling the same need, so liking one tubing kit does not mean I want another."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on project interests but stretched them beyond my demonstrated wiring needs into unsupported printing and specialized hardware needs."
}
